claim: Meta's next fiscal year revenue will reach $64B.
summary: Meta's latest filed annual revenue is FY2025 $200,966,000,000 (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, filed 2026-01-29, fiscal_equals_calendar=true). Lookup for FY2026 annual revenue returns fact_not_found; no FY2026 10-K is available as of 2026-10-22 coverage, with only FY2026Q1-Q3 filed. FY2026 Q1 $56,311,000,000 + Q2 $60,801,000,000 + Q3 $64,601,000,000 already sum to $181,713,000,000, making an exact annual total of $64B inconsistent with filed YTD, but the complete FY2026 annual figure is not yet determinable from SEC filings because it is forward-looking and not filed.
